defs.def: words that show approval of or admiration for sb/sth 赞扬；称赞；赞美

ex.s: The teachers praised her, and friends gathered around her, requesting her to sing.
ex.t: 老师们称赞她，朋友们围在她身边，请求她唱歌。

ex.s: The teachers were smiling and praising me.
ex.t: 老师们微笑着称赞我。

ex.s: Typically, cruelty and cheating are discouraged, while cooperation, humbleness and courage are praised.
ex.t: 通常，残忍和欺骗受到谴责，而合作、谦逊和勇气则受到赞扬。

ex.s: For these reasons, they are praised as “coastal guardians”.
ex.t: 由于这些原因，它们被誉为"海岸卫士"。

ex.s: In the sciences and arts, those praised as geniuses were most often white men, of European origin.
ex.t: 在科学和艺术领域，那些被誉为天才的人往往是欧洲裔白人男性。

ex.s: Young job seekers are known to be overconfident because they have been praised for everything they have done.
ex.t: 年轻的求职者以过度自信著称，因为他们所做的一切都受到过赞扬。

ex.s: Parents everywhere praise their kids.
ex.t: 各地的父母都称赞他们的孩子。

ex.s: Not giving enough praise can be just as damaging gas giving too much.
ex.t: 不给予足够的赞扬可能和给予过多一样有害。

ex.s: Experts say that the quality of praise is more important than the quantity.
ex.t: 专家说，赞扬的质量比数量更重要。

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 如果赞美是真诚的，并且专注于努力而不是结果，那么你可以像孩子做一些值得口头奖励的事情一样频繁地给予赞美。” 我们应当特别承认我们的孩子努力推动自己并努力实现一个目标，即“无恐惧地养育子女：让忧心忡忡地去关注真正重要的事情”的作者多纳休(Donahue)说。

ex.s: He also won praise from social media users after Mr Anderson    31    about the act of kindness on Facebook.
ex.t: 在安德森先生在脸书上____31____这一善举后，他也赢得了社交媒体用户的赞扬。

ex.s: It has been an enormously positive force." Watched by millions, the ending to the race has divided opinions: should the brothers have been disqualified or highly praised for their actions?
ex.t: “它一直是一股极为积极的力量。”在数百万人的注视下，比赛结局引发了分歧：兄弟俩的行为应该被取消资格，还是受到高度赞扬？

ex.s: So why have the movies based on The Great Gatsby never been praised as “great”?
ex.t: 那么为什么基于《了不起的盖茨比》的电影从未被称赞为＂伟大＂呢？

ex.s: All the horses in your stables are my very teachers.” 5 Those who saw Han Gan’s horse paintings all sang high praises for his unique skill, saying that his horses “could gallop off the paper”.
ex.t: 你马厩里的每一匹马都是我的老师。＂ 5 见过韩幹画马的人无不对他独特的技艺赞不绝口，说他的马＂仿佛能跃然纸上＂。

ex.s: However, the image Jade presents to obtain the praise of others is false.
ex.t: 然而，杰德为了获得他人的赞赏而展现的形象是虚假的。

ex.s: Instead, one activist, dressed in a full-body monkey suit, had arrived with a sign praising the filmmakers: "Thanks for not using real apes (猿)!"
ex.t: 相反，一位身着全身猴子装的活动人士举着一块称赞电影制作人的牌子出现：“感谢你们没有使用真猿！”

ex.s: Too much praise can backfire and, when given in a way that's insincere, make kids afraid to try new things or take a risk for fear of not being able to stay on top where their parents' praise has put them.
ex.t: 过多的表扬可能适得其反，而且当表扬以不真诚的方式给出时，会让孩子害怕尝试新事物或冒险，担心无法保持在父母表扬把他们放到的那个顶端位置。

defs.def: the expression of worship to God （对上帝的）颂扬，赞颂
to express your approval or admiration for sb/sth 表扬；赞扬；称赞

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

ex.s: So what is the right amount of praise?
ex.t: 那么，多少表扬才合适呢？

ex.s: Praising the effort and not the outcome can also mean recognizing your child when she has worked hard to clean the yard, cook dinner, or finish a book report.
ex.t: 表扬努力而非结果，也意味着当孩子努力清扫院子、做饭或完成读书报告时认可她。

ex.s: Anne was praised in class, and she felt happy as well as ashamed.
ex.t: 安妮在课上受到表扬，她既高兴又感到羞愧。

ex.s: To praise veterinarians.
ex.t: 为了赞扬兽医。

ex.s: To praise their writing skills.
ex.t: 为了赞扬他们的写作技巧。

ex.s: But if he's out there every day and playing hard, you should praise his effort regardless of whether his team wins or loses.
ex.t: 但如果他每天都在那里努力打球，无论他的球队输赢，你都应该赞扬他的努力。

ex.s: To praise the effectiveness of America’s road system.
ex.t: 赞扬美国道路系统的有效性。

ex.s: When he brings his speech to a nice conclusion ,Whaley invites the rest of the class to praise him.
ex.t: 当他把演讲讲到一个很好的结论时，华利邀请班里其他人来赞美他。

defs.def: to express your thanks to or your respect for God 颂扬，赞颂（上帝）
